verification.groups: standard 1-140 and ABR 1-140: group multisets (bloon, modifiers, count) identical between topper64/cyberquincy (2024) and bloonswiki (2026) - 0 differences in 280 rounds.
verification.rbe: identical between cyberquincy and bloonswiki for standard 1-140 and ABR 1-100.

difficulty_notes.easy: Rounds 1-40, 200 lives, prices 0.85x Medium. R40 MOAB has 133 HP.
difficulty_notes.hard: Starts at round 3 with $650, ends after round 80, 100 lives, prices 1.08x Medium (rounded to $5 per item). Bloons move ~13.6% faster than Medium (25% faster than Easy). Bloon HP is NOT scaled; R80 is a single ZOMG.
difficulty_notes.impoppable: Rounds 6-100, $650 start, 1 life, prices 1.2x Medium (~11% above Hard), Mana Shield disabled. R81+ apply freeplay ramping (blimp HP +2%/round, speed +2%/round, super ceramics).
difficulty_notes.chimps: Rounds 6-100 like Impoppable plus: no Continues (Retry Last Round instead), 1 life, no Monkey Knowledge, no Powers/Insta Monkeys, no Hero Boosters, no selling, no income except starting cash, pop cash and end-of-round cash (end-of-round bonus IS paid since v1.7). Banana Farms disabled; Double Cash and perks don't apply.
difficulty_notes.double_hp: Hard rounds 3-80; every MOAB-class bloon has 2x HP (stacks with fortified): R40 MOAB = 400 HP, R80 ZOMG = 8,000.
difficulty_notes.half_cash: Hard rounds 3-80; starting cash ($325), pop cash, end-of-round cash and income are all halved.
difficulty_notes.abr: Alternate Bloons Rounds: Hard difficulty (rounds 3-80, 100 lives, 1.08x prices) with the ABR round set. Camo from R5, lead R10, purple R15, ceramic R32, fortified MOAB on R40, BFB R54, ZOMG R79, DDT R88 (freeplay).
difficulty_notes.magic_only: Hard rounds 3-80, only Magic towers + heroes.
difficulty_notes.military_only: Medium rounds 1-60, only Military towers + heroes.
difficulty_notes.primary_only: Easy rounds 1-40, only Primary towers + heroes.
difficulty_notes.apopalypse: Medium; rounds are random and sent continuously (no data here).
difficulty_notes.reverse: Medium; each round's groups are sent in reverse order (same contents).

children.note: fortified blimps spawn fortified children; fortified ceramic -> 2 normal rainbows. From R81 every non-blimp bloon spawns only ONE child and ceramics become super ceramics (60 HP).

speed_u_s.note: bloonswiki base speeds (red = 25 units/s). Hard is ~13.6% faster than Medium (25% faster than Easy) per bloonswiki 'Hard'; multiply by speed_mult for R81+.

immunities.ddt: sharp, shatter, cold, energy, explosion (+ camo)

blimp_hp.easy_r40_moab: On Easy the R40 MOAB has 133 HP (549 RBE).

hard.need: $650 opener that pops R3-R10 (reds/blues/greens)
hard.why: Hard starts at round 3 with $650; first tower must cost <= $650 (Dart $215, Ninja $430, Sniper $380, Sub $350 on Hard).

hard.need: pierce vs 12 regrow yellows in 5 s
hard.why: First regrow round (12 regrow yellows bunched in 5 s).

hard.need: a non-explosive damage source
hard.why: 6 black bloons: immune to explosions (a lone Bomb Shooter leaks). Bomb 0-0-2 Frag Bombs or any sharp tower.

hard.need: a non-cold damage source
hard.why: 16 whites in 8 s: immune to freezing (Ice needs 2-0-0 Cold Snap).

hard.need: camo detection
hard.why: First camo: 1 camo green (R24). Real camo DPS needed by R33 (20 camo reds + 13 camo yellows), R36 (20 camo regrow greens), R37 (7 camo whites).

hard.need: a non energy/plasma/fire damage source
hard.why: First purples (10). Purple is immune to energy, plasma, fire and frigid: Wizard bolts, Super 1-2-x/2-x-x plasma, Tack Hot Shots/Ring of Fire, Druid lightning can't pop them.

hard.need: lead popping
hard.why: First leads: 6 leads (R28), 9 (R30), 15 (R37), 14 (R38). Sniper 1-0-0 handles R28/R30; R37/38 need more.

hard.need: ceramic DPS (10 HP layer + 47 RBE under it)
hard.why: First ceramics (2 on R38); R43: 7 ceramics + 10 rainbows in 9.3 s; R46: 6 fortified ceramics (20 HP).

hard.need: ~200 blimp damage during the MOAB's transit + clean-up of 4 ceramics
hard.why: Single MOAB: 200 HP, 616 RBE (4 ceramics x 104). MOAB speed 25 u/s x ~1.136 on Hard = ~28 u/s. Rule: sum over towers of blimp_DPS x (covered track units / 28.4) >= 1.5 x 200. Sniper 3-0-0 (12.6 DPS map-wide) solos it if the track takes >16 s; a Mauler covering ~90 units only adds ~60 dmg.

hard.need: 4-damage lead popping (fortified leads take 4 hits)
hard.why: 4 fortified leads + 10 camo purples + 180 pinks (2,289 RBE). Camo purple = camo + no energy/plasma/fire.

hard.need: 2 MOABs + 20 ceramics + 8 fortified leads (3,540 RBE)
hard.why: Two MOABs (one at the start, one at the end) plus ceramics; also R52-R57 send 1-4 MOABs with ceramics.

hard.need: camo ceramic DPS
hard.why: 15 camo ceramics + 10 regrow rainbows; R53 80 camo pinks; R56 40 camo rainbows.

hard.need: camo + lead on the same damage (or decamo)
hard.why: First camo leads: 50 camo leads + 20 ceramics + 10 regrow ceramics (4,270 RBE).

hard.need: ~700 blimp damage in transit (BFB 6.25 u/s, slow) + 4 MOABs inside
hard.why: First BFB: 700 HP, 3,164 RBE (4 MOABs -> 16 ceramics). MOAB Assassin's 750-dmg ability one-shots the BFB layer.

hard.need: fortified-blimp damage + purple popping
hard.why: First fortified MOABs (2 x 400 HP) with 5 MOABs, 250 purples and 15 camo regrow rainbows (8,247 RBE).

hard.need: ceramic rush: 122 ceramics + 75 leads in 42 s (14,413 RBE)
hard.why: The first big wall. 122 ceramic layers x 10 HP = 1,220 HP of ceramic shell arriving in 3 clumps (t=3.9 s, 20.1 s, 36.4 s) plus 75 leads. Needs area damage that pops lead: e.g. Boomerang 3-0-2, Tack 4-2-0, Ninja 4-0-2 + Alch 4-2-0, Sniper 3-2-0 x2, Super 3-0-2.

hard.need: blimp burst: 6 MOAB + 3 fortified MOAB in 9.5 s = 2,400 blimp HP
hard.why: Densest early blimp round (6,264 RBE in 9.5 s); R66 (8 MOAB + 3 fortified), R68 (4 MOAB + BFB in 8.4 s) follow.

hard.need: mixed wall: 100 zebras, 70 rainbows, 50 ceramics, 3 MOAB, 2 BFB (18,966 RBE)
hard.why: Zebras are black+white (no explosion, no freeze).

hard.need: fortified camo regrow ceramics (13) + 8 MOAB
hard.why: Needs camo + regrow handling + 20-HP ceramic shells.

hard.need: 40 fortified leads + 40 regrow blacks + 50 ceramics
hard.why: Fortified leads (4 HP) and blacks (explosion-immune) together: bombs alone fail.

hard.need: 120 camo regrow whites + 200 rainbows + 4 MOAB (13,184 RBE)
hard.why: Camo + regrow + freeze-immune swarm.

hard.need: ceramic wall 2: 50 ceramic, 25 fortified camo regrow ceramic, 60 fortified ceramic, 1 BFB (18,054 RBE, 82 s)
hard.why: Long fortified ceramic round; camo needed for the 25 crf-ceramics.

hard.need: 7 BFB + 3 fortified MOAB + 28 leads (14 fortified) in 22.6 s (25,402 RBE)
hard.why: Blimp-dense round; 6,100 blimp HP on the top layer (7 x 700 + 3 x 400).

hard.need: 60 regrow ceramics in 1.8 s
hard.why: All 60 spawn almost at once (6,240 RBE): needs burst ceramic damage or regrow block (Village 0-1-0, Engineer 0-3-0, Druid 0-2-0).

hard.need: 11 MOAB + 5 BFB (22,596 RBE, 5,700 blimp HP)
hard.why: Sustained blimp DPS.

hard.need: 150 rainbows, 75 ceramics, 80 purples, 72 camo ceramics, 1 BFB (26,382 RBE, 90 s)
hard.why: Long mixed round: purple + camo ceramics + BFB.

hard.need: 500 regrow rainbows + 4 BFB + 2 fortified BFB (45,804 RBE)
hard.why: Highest-RBE round before 80. 2 fortified BFBs = 1,400 HP each; plus 500 regrow rainbows.

hard.need: ~4,000 blimp damage on one ZOMG (4.5 u/s) + 4 BFB + 16 MOAB + 64 ceramics
hard.why: Final Hard round: 1 ZOMG, 16,656 RBE. ZOMG is very slow (~5.1 u/s on Hard) so time-in-range is long: 100 track units = ~19.6 s.
